fusions.name: Slammed Shut
fusions.desc: Bars of chain slam shut around you, which deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stuns each for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Inescapable] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Warden's Lock
fusions.desc: Casts a shackle at the first enemy it meets that deals 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and leaves it [Suppressed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Behind Bars
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Cell of Last Resort
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
